title: Nixer Fruza Mandarin Mango Freeze 30ml Longfill E-Liquid
description: Discover a vibrant and frosty tropical mix with Nixer - Fruza Mandarin Mango Freeze. This flavour concentrate pairs the juicy, sweet notes of ripe Mango with the sharp, zesty tang of Mandarin. A powerful cooling freeze effect rounds out the profile for a bold and invigorating vape. This 60ml bottle contains 30ml of 0mg flavour concentrate suspended in PG. It is **not** designed to be vaped on its own and **must** be combined with a Nixer Mixer Kit (sold separately) to create 60ml of finished e-liquid. The Nixer system gives you complete control. Simply choose your Fruza flavour concentrate, then add your preferred Nixer Mixer Kit (sold separately) to create your perfect e-liquid. You can choose from 70/30 Sub-Ohm blends or 50/50 MTL blends in Freebase or Nic Salt options, with strengths ranging from 0mg to 10mg. Customisation Options: Freebase N3 Mixer Kit: 60ml of 3mg freebase e-liquid (70% VG) Freebase N6 Mixer Kit: 60ml of 6mg freebase e-liquid (70% VG) Nic Salt N5 Mixer Kit: 60ml of 5mg nic salt e-liquid (50% VG) Nic Salt N10 Mixer Kit: 60ml of 10mg nic salt e-liquid (50% VG) Nic Salt Ice N5 Mixer Kit: 60ml of 5mg ice nic salt e-liquid (50% VG) Nic Salt Ice N10 Mixer Kit: 60ml of 10mg ice nic salt e-liquid (50% VG) How To Use NIXER Mixer Kit Step 1 Open your 30ml Nixer concentrate and remove the nib. Step 2 Pour in all three 10ml bottles from your chosen Nixer Mixer Kit. Step 3 Re-insert the nib and secure the cap. Step 4 Shake the bottle vigorously for one minute. Step 5 Your 60ml e-liquid is now ready to vape! ✅ You're all set! Please Note: Longfill flavour concentrates are not designed to be vaped on its own – they must be mixed with a VG + Nic Shot (optional) mixer kit first. Nixer e-liquids are made in the UK by Dispergo, and are designed to be paired with Nixer Mixer Kits, allowing you to craft 60ml of vape juice with your preferred composition and strength. The mixer kits are available in freebase, Nic Salt and Menthol Nic Salt (Ice) formulations to allow for several styles of vaping and compatibility with many types of vape kit.
